correctness.rationale: All finite-dimensional and characteristic boundary cases are covered. The key normal form follows from right-translation transitivity in each U-fiber, additivity of connected Alexander-quandle maps with zero value, and the cross-fiber coefficient identities that force one common linear A and one common b. The identity \(F^2=F\) gives exactly \(\phi^2=\phi\), \(A^2=A\), and \(Ab=0\); semisimple module decomposition makes projection images/direct complements independent. Counts of invariant images, complements, cosets, and label retracts give the displayed exact formula with no unstated linearity assumption. The full operation-table independent checker exhausts all quandle endomorphisms for sizes 1,3,4,5,8,9 and compares idempotent ranks and individual-image multiplicities across seven instances. The proof, not finite tests, establishes the infinite-dimensional-family claim.

value.rationale: The existence of a nonzero 1-eigenspace makes the quandle disconnected and allows nonlinear endomorphisms: this is not an ordinary linear module-retraction count. The theorem determines its full endomorphism monoid, all attainable retract-image cardinalities, every actual image subset, and the multiplicity onto each prescribed image for every semisimple prime-field operator, including extension-field simple factors and characteristic two. The product formula isolates the nonlinear label factor \(k^{Q-k}\) from Gaussian module factors, and the maximum proper-image boundary \(Q(Q-1)\) is uniform in the nontrivial spectrum. These are natural complete structural/enumerative invariants of an infinite class, not an arbitrary finite slice.
